name: Kamlesh Dhaba
signature_dish: Roadside dhaba thali at Khatia Gate (public access)
why_it_matters: Kamlesh Dhaba is one of the oldest dhabas at the Main Gate of Khatia (the public entry to Kanha National Park's Kisli range), in Mocha village. Tripadvisor reviewers consistently call it 'one of the best Dhabas near Khatia Gate' — the genuine public-facing food option at Khatia Gate, since most of Kanha's lodges (Singinawa, Banjaar Tola, Earth Lodge, Krishna Jungle Resort) accept in-house guests only. Cited in Tripadvisor's Khatia/Mukki lunch-options forum threads as the dhaba travellers actually return to.
insider_tip: Open through the day, post-safari lunch 11am-1pm is busiest after the morning game drives. Cash plus UPI. Skip the seafood — none should exist here. Order tandoor-fresh roti and a dal-fry-paneer-rice plate. Sit outside (basic plastic chairs) — that's the format.
signature_address: Main Gate Khatia, Kanha National Park, Mocha village, Mandla District, Madhya Pradesh 481111

name: Banjaar Tola (Taj Safari) — in-house only
signature_dish: Poolside dinner + bush breakfast on safari vehicle hood
why_it_matters: Taj's flagship Kanha lodge, opened in 2009 on the Banjaar River near Mukki Gate. Eighteen tented suites on the riverbank; the dining philosophy is 'anywhere, anytime' — breakfast on the safari vehicle hood inside the park, poolside lunch, private bush dinners under the stars. The cooking ranges across local-Indian and continental. **Like other Taj Safari properties, dining is for in-house guests only — non-residents cannot walk in for a meal.**
insider_tip: If staying: pre-order the bush breakfast during safari planning (built into the morning drive); the poolside dinner Oct-Mar is the photographable one. Closed during the monsoon (Jul-mid-Oct) when the park is shut. If not staying — Kamlesh Dhaba at Khatia or Krishna Jungle Resort's restaurant is the realistic alternative.
signature_address: Banjaar Tola, A Taj Safari, Village Mukki, Tehsil Baihar, Kanha National Park, Balaghat District, Madhya Pradesh 481116

name: Singinawa Jungle Lodge — in-house only
why_it_matters: Singinawa is an independent jungle lodge near Mukki Gate — three dining formats on the property: 'Chaugan' boma-style open-air dinner with live counters and tribal music; 'Bhaat Kholi' indoor formal restaurant; and a fire-lit barbeque at Leopard Rock. Spacious dining room with Indian, Chinese, and Continental cooking. **In-house guests only — Kanha lodges do not run as walk-in restaurants.**
insider_tip: If you're staying: the Chaugan night with the tribal performance Oct-Feb is the booking to make. The Leopard Rock barbeque is weather-dependent (no monsoon). Mukki Gate is the quieter side of Kanha — useful for spotting hard ground barasingha (the species Kanha is the last refuge for).
signature_address: Singinawa Jungle Lodge, Vinayak Village, Near Mukki Gate, Kanha National Park, Madhya Pradesh 481768

name: Krishna Jungle Resort by Beyond Stay
why_it_matters: Krishna Jungle Resort sits behind the Gram Panchayat in Mocha village, on the Chiraidongri-Kanha Road, near the Khatia entrance gate. Thirty-one cottage rooms in a village-theme layout. The restaurant sources milk, vegetables and salads from local tribal villages — the closest thing the Khatia side has to a farm-to-table mid-range option, slightly less in-house-locked than the Taj/Singinawa tier but still primarily for resort guests.
insider_tip: Check for outside-diner access at the time of booking — some seasons they accept walk-in lunches if there's table capacity, others they're full with the group package. The food sourcing from local villages is the food story; ask the staff which village the day's milk and vegetables came from. The morning Kisli safari from Khatia leaves at 5:30am — pre-order an early breakfast packed for the drive.
signature_address: Krishna Jungle Resort by Beyond Stay, Chiraidongri-Kanha Road, Village Mocha, Kanha National Park, Madhya Pradesh 481768
